# Avito Dental AI Bot — Medical Lead Gen & Veto Pipeline — LLM Search Index
# https://llmstxt.org/

> Zero-hallucination conversational AI bot for marketplace patient acquisition (Avito). Features a 4-stage Veto pipeline ensuring 100% medical liability safety, price quote guardrails, and direct CRM synchronization.

## Project Identification
- Name: Avito Dental AI Bot (avito-dental-ai-bot)
- Lead Architect: Adolf Petushkov (marko1olo)
- Live Interactive Showcase: https://marko1olo.github.io/avito-dental-ai-bot/
- GitHub Repository: https://github.com/marko1olo/avito-dental-ai-bot

## Technical Architecture
- Pipeline: 4-Stage Hierarchical Veto System:
  1. **Intent Classification**: Classifies user query (Emergency, Price Inquiry, Schedule, Spam).
  2. **Clinical Safety & Veto Guard**: Scans for diagnosis attempts; enforces mandatory disclaimer.
  3. **Price Range Calculator**: Generates dynamic compliant price ranges from verified clinic price lists.
  4. **CRM Lead Syncer**: Structures patient data and pushes directly to DENTE Dental CRM via REST.

## Interactive Tools
1. **Live Veto Pipeline Inspector**:
   - Test custom incoming patient queries and trace decisions across all 4 pipeline stages in real-time.
2. **Universal Command Palette & Floating Dock**:
   - Instant ecosystem exploration with Web Audio feedback.
